publication_scope: The portable deterministic generator and complete literal/native/outer checks establish the positive relay. Search programs and logs are provenance only; failed flow searches do not establish impossibility or attainment of the static cap.

relay.edge_rule: Move one existing width7 role into a vacancy bin only at its actual strict source window and a family unused at that call in the original complete allocation. Each intermediate bin is originally full; two paths have disjoint intermediate bins and use distinct terminal roles.
relay.interpretation: One positive legal literal witness; no optimality or completeness claim for the relay domain.
relay.search_restrictions: Each call time is indexed at most once per BFS after a receiver with an available physical family accepts that time; each donor bin is visited at most once. The second path excludes the first path intermediate bins and its terminal role. This bounded search is not an exhaustive census of all legal relays.
relay.threshold_semantics: After expanding all eligible times for a receiver bin, stop the first-path BFS when the number of discovered terminal bins is at least40. This is a post-expansion stopping threshold, not a hard cap on examined or discovered terminal states. The recorded first BFS discovered3281 terminal states before its threshold check.
